_about: #8399: a SEAM/LEAK term for the per-call translation cells. The page-acceptance judge reads one page at a time and cannot see a defect between two pages; these rates are the #7118 Opus seam judge's, per 100 page joins (0.75 x in-block T + 0.25 x block-start S), and the leaks the translation call itself made (Amendment 2 classes). Same 120 blocks for every arm, agy gemini-3.8-flash-low. Write-up: scripts/eval/experiments/2026-11-08-seam-markers-4-per-call-8399.md; verdicts: scripts/eval/results/seam-markers-8399/report.json.

routes.agy-flash-low@4: production: claude-translate.mjs --cli=agy --per-call=4, page tags, previous-page English (arms A, A2)
routes.agy-flash-low@4-marked: one marked text per 4 pages, no previous English (B4)
routes.agy-flash-low@4-marked-8000: marked, source budget 8,000 characters a call (Bb)
routes.agy-flash-low@4-marked-8000+seam: Bb + one agy seam call per call boundary (C)

decision: keep agy-flash-low@4 on both cells (the registered rule: Bb fails the seam clause, B4 the dense usable clause; only the seam pass passes, which the preregistration routes to a follow-up)
